title: HWE-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Hardware Bug Repair Tasks
authors_zh: Fan Cui, Hongyuan Hou, Zizhang Luo, Chenyun Yin, Yun Liang
paper_type_zh: 带原生仿真验证的仓库级硬件修复基准
best_for_zh: 研究 HDL 代理、硬件修复和仿真式奖励的研究者。
one_line: HWE-Bench evaluates hardware agents on real repository bugs using native simulation and regression tests.
HWE-Bench 在真实硬件仓库上以原生仿真和回归测试评估代理修复历史 bug 的能力。
why: It brings execution-verified, repository-level repair evaluation to RTL and hardware-software artifacts.
inclusion_reason: HWE-Bench releases repository-level hardware repair tasks verified by native simulation and regression tests.

title: Problem
问题
html: Hardware-code benchmarks mostly generate isolated HDL modules from specifications and do not test agents on historical bugs spanning RTL, configuration, firmware, and verification files in real SoC repositories. HWE-Bench builds repository-level repair tasks from real pull requests. Agents read issue descriptions and full codebases, submit patches, and are judged by native simulation or regression flows. The goal is hardware-semantic reasoning and cross-artifact coordination, not merely Verilog syntax.
硬件代码 benchmark 多要求从规格生成单个 HDL 模块，无法测试代理在真实 SoC 仓库中定位跨 RTL、配置、固件和验证文件的历史 bug。HWE-Bench 从真实 pull request 构建仓库级修复任务，代理读取 issue 和完整代码库、提交补丁，并由项目原生仿真或回归流程判定。目标是测量硬件语义推理与跨 artifact 协调，而非只检查 Verilog 语法。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: HWE-Bench contains 417 tasks from six major open-source hardware projects covering Verilog/SystemVerilog and Chisel, RISC-V cores, SoCs, and roots of trust. Each JSONL record includes repository and PR metadata, problem statement, ground-truth patch, test patch, modified files, bug categories, container preparation, and hidden fail-to-pass tests, with pass-to-pass outcomes when available. The pipeline verifies that the buggy baseline fails native simulation and the reference fix passes before containerization.

HWE-Bench 含 417 个任务，来自六个大型开源硬件项目，覆盖 Verilog/SystemVerilog 与 Chisel、RISC-V 核、SoC 和安全 root-of-trust。每条 JSONL 记录含仓库/PR、问题描述、ground-truth patch、测试补丁、修改文件、bug 类别、容器准备脚本和隐藏 fail-to-pass 测试；部分还记录 pass-to-pass 等结果。构建者确认错误基线在原生仿真中失败、参考修复通过，再封装容器。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Mine repair PRs: Select real hardware bugs from six projects and parse patches, issues, and relevant tests.
  1. Construct reproducers: Use existing tests, minimal testbenches, or full-system software paths so the buggy revision fails reliably.
  1. Validate reference fixes: Apply ground-truth patches and run native build, simulation, and regression flows in containers, confirming fail-to-pass behavior.
  1. Evaluate agents: Provide issues and repositories while hiding fixes, apply candidate patches, and execute tests. Reproduction must fix images, EDA licences, random seeds, timeouts, and submodules.

1. 挖掘修复 PR： 从六个项目筛选真实硬件 bug，解析补丁、issue 和相关测试。
  1. 构造复现器： 选择已有测试、最小 testbench 或全系统软件路径，使旧版本稳定失败。
  1. 验证参考修复： 应用 ground-truth patch，在容器中运行项目原生编译、仿真和回归，确认 fail-to-pass。
  1. 评测代理： 提供问题与仓库但隐藏修复，应用候选补丁并执行测试。复现需固定镜像、EDA 工具许可、随机种子、超时和仓库子模块。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates seven LLMs with four agent frameworks. The best agent solves 70.7% overall, exceeds 90% on smaller core projects, and falls below 65% on complex SoCs. Failures are traced to fault localization, hardware-semantic reasoning, and coordination across RTL, configuration, and verification artifacts; project scope and bug type explain difficulty better than code size. This supports real-repository evaluation, although some OpenTitan flows require Synopsys VCS and are not fully open.

论文评测七个 LLM 与四种代理框架，最佳代理总体解决率为 70.7%；在较小处理器核项目上超过 90%，在复杂 SoC 项目上低于 65%。失败分析将问题分为 fault localization、硬件语义推理以及 RTL/配置/验证跨 artifact 协调，且项目范围和 bug 类型比代码行数更能解释难度。结果支持真实仓库 benchmark 的必要性，但部分 OpenTitan 流程依赖 Synopsys VCS，环境开放性有限。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier HDLRepair and VerilogEval-style work focuses on module generation or local repair, while SWE-bench-like tasks target software repositories. HWE-Bench extends fail-to-pass tasks to real hardware repositories while preserving native simulation, firmware paths, and cross-layer bug categories. It changes the data object and execution environment rather than introducing a new hardware-agent algorithm.
已有 HDLRepair、VerilogEval 等主要测试模块生成或局部修复，SWE-bench 式任务又集中软件仓库。HWE-Bench 的新意是将 fail-to-pass 任务扩展到真实硬件仓库，并保留原生仿真、固件路径和跨层 bug 分类。它改变的是数据对象和执行环境，不是提出新的硬件代理算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Tool licences: Some projects require commercial EDA tools, preventing full distribution of public images.
  1. Incomplete tests: Native regressions verify known bugs and related behavior but may miss new hardware errors introduced by patches.
  1. Project concentration: Six high-quality open projects do not cover private IP, physical design, timing closure, or FPGA board issues. Reuse should report fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass results and include patch review.

1. 工具许可： 某些项目需要商业 EDA 工具，公开镜像无法完整分发，降低复现性。
  1. 测试不完备： 原生回归只验证已知 bug 和相关行为，候选补丁仍可能引入未测硬件错误。
  1. 项目集中： 六个高质量开源项目不能覆盖私有 IP、物理设计、时序收敛和 FPGA 板级问题。复用时应报告 f2p/p2p 并进行补丁审查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate hardware-repair agents: Report resolve rates in full repositories and containers, decomposed by project and bug layer.
  1. Train execution verifiers: Use candidate patches, simulation logs, and fail-to-pass/pass-to-pass labels for hardware reward models.
  1. Expand tasks: Reuse PR mining, reproducer construction, and reference-fix validation. Static compilation should not substitute for simulation when stable or distributable tests are unavailable.

1. 评测硬件修复 agent： 在完整仓库和容器中报告 resolve rate，并按项目与 bug 层级分解。
  1. 训练执行 verifier： 用候选补丁、仿真日志和 f2p/p2p 标签训练硬件奖励模型。
  1. 扩充任务： 复用 PR 挖掘、reproducer 构建和参考修复验证流程。若没有稳定仿真器或测试无法合法分发，不应把静态编译当成等价替代。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: HWE-Bench evaluates repository-level hardware bug repair on 417 real pull requests.
  2. Method takeaway: PR mining, reproducers, containerized native simulation, and fail-to-pass decisions.
  3. Data takeaway: JSONL records include patches, tests, categories, scripts, and multiple test outcomes.
  4. Evidence anchor: Best overall is 70.7%, above 90% on small cores and below 65% on complex SoCs.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits HDL agents, with commercial EDA dependencies and test incompleteness explicitly audited.

1. 一句话定位： HWE-Bench 用 417 个真实 PR 测试硬件代理的仓库级 bug 修复。
  2. 方法抓手： PR 挖掘、reproducer、容器化原生仿真和 fail-to-pass 判定。
  3. 数据抓手： JSONL 含 patch、测试、类别、脚本和多类测试结果。
  4. 证据锚点： 最佳总体 70.7%，小核超 90%，复杂 SoC 低于 65%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 HDL agent；商业 EDA 依赖和测试不完备必须显式审计。
